sections.label: The opening
sections.line: Mapping an Agent Behaviour Policy onto Manus: wide reach, real controls, and a record of the gap between them.
sections.para: Manus works in a cloud computer, on your computer, in your browser with your logins, across 416 connectors and in unattended automations. Its documentation describes real controls and says what they leave open. An Agent Behaviour Policy records reach, mandate, gap and the control that holds each row, and can live in four places: read, set, gate and attest. The first two exist in Manus; the last two are proposals. Nothing has been run on Manus yet.

sections.label: In short
sections.line: Wide reach, real controls, the policy as the missing record, four places it lives, nothing tested yet.
sections.para: Six points from Manus's documentation, read on 9 November 2026.

sections.label: Why Manus, and why now
sections.line: Manus is on Web Summit's opening night, independent again after China blocked Meta's purchase.
sections.para: Meta's roughly $2 billion deal was blocked on 27 April 2026; Manus raised more than $500 million in October. For RiskMandate it is the agent with the most reach a business can switch on in an afternoon.

sections.label: What Manus can reach
sections.line: A cloud sandbox, your computer, your browser and logins, 416 connectors, automations, email, Projects and Skills.
sections.para: Each item is a row in an Agent Behaviour Policy.

sections.label: The controls Manus already gives you
sections.line: Permission modes, session approval, approved senders, conditions; and a candid statement of the gaps.
sections.para: Approval modes limit changes, not reading; planning happens in the Manus cloud. The controls are barriers, the candid sentences are gaps.

sections.label: A policy for one Manus deployment
sections.line: An invented morning prospecting task, as reach, mandate, gap and barrier.
sections.para: Send email, everything a LinkedIn session can do, edit and delete deals, running unattended and instructions inside forwarded email: each with a setting, an instruction, or open.

sections.label: Four places the policy lives
sections.line: Read, set, gate, attest: a Project instruction or Skill, Manus settings, a custom MCP gate, evidence and sign-off.
sections.para: Read and set exist today; a gate for internal systems and attestation from Manus's logs are proposals.

sections.label: What RiskMandate could offer Manus users
sections.line: Templates per Manus surface, the policy as a Skill, the five-minute try in Manus, and a policy per Project.
sections.para: The Skill and the try are proposed and untested.

sections.label: What this does not claim
sections.line: Not run on Manus; the deployment is invented; gate and attest are proposals.
sections.para: No judgement of Manus's safety, and no relationship with Manus.

sections.label: Where this comes from
sections.line: Manus's documentation pages, three news reports, riskmandate.ai and earlier newsroom articles.
